name: Klaus
backstory: Klaus is a wood elf at the Circus of the Last Days. Along with Benji, he is tasked with sniffing people out. If Benji smells blood, they do not allow entrance to the circus.
voice_hint: wood elf sorcerer (voiced by Thomas Mitchells)
